applied_edits.subject: westfall
applied_edits.content: I'm realizing the bare rats and peasants aren't worth the exhaustion; I want to explore Stormgarde with someone who needs a break.

applied_edits.subject: stromgarde
applied_edits.content: Stromgarde is where the real heart is; Westfall is just filler until I can finally get back in on the weekend.

applied_edits.subject: the inn
applied_edits.content: I need to stop pretending I can catch up; the XP won't matter if I'm too fried to enjoy the world I'm grinding through.

applied_edits.subject: lynea
applied_edits.content: I'm going to stop rushing Westfall and head to the inn with Lynea to actually talk to her while she steadies her hands.

applied_edits.subject: rushing
applied_edits.content: The grind is making me feel like I'm missing the point, so I'm letting go of the need to hit level 20 before Saturday.

applied_edits.subject: burnout
applied_edits.content: man, i'm running on fumes trying to get to 20 before saturday rolls around, so i'm just happy to be staring at the sunstone for a change.

applied_edits.subject: resentment
applied_edits.content: catch me up on whatever i missed while at work, it's actually nice to chat with someone new, been too busy grinding westfall to really say hi to people lately.

applied_edits.subject: adaptation
applied_edits.content: westfall feels a little bare at this level, just too many rats and not enough fun compared to stromgarde, maybe hit the inn for a beer and catch up on the chat later?

applied_edits.subject: mount
applied_edits.content: Finally got my Epic Flying Mount unlocked; no more rushing across the map on foot.

applied_edits.subject: death knight
applied_edits.content: Just leveled up my Death Knight alt in Outland; the new zones are so much more fun than Westfall.

applied_edits.subject: outland
applied_edits.content: Spent the whole Saturday dailies in Outland; the scenery and mobs are way better than the rats in Westfall.
